E04.quote: In no event shall Distributor be entitled to recover lost profits or other consequential damages from Company.
E04.explanation: This clause excludes the recovery of lost profits and consequential damages, fitting the definition of limiting damages types.

E06.quote: SUBJECT TO THE FOREGOING, EACH PARTY'S LIABILITY IS LIMITED TO THE FEES PAID.
E06.explanation: This clause limits overall liability to the fees paid.

E06.quote: THE EXCLUSIONS AND LIMITATIONS IN THIS ARTICLE SHALL NOT APPLY TO CLAIMS FOR INDEMNIFICATION UNDER ARTICLE 9 OR TO BREACHES OF ARTICLE 7 (CONFIDENTIALITY);
E06.explanation: This clause carves out specific claims from the liability cap, making them uncapped.

E08.quote: Distributor shall be liable for all losses of any kind resulting from its breach of this Agreement, without limitation.
E08.explanation: This clause explicitly states that liability is without limitation for certain breaches.

E10.quote: The validity, interpretation and performance of this Agreement shall be determined under the laws of the Province of Ontario
E10.explanation: This clause specifies which jurisdiction's law governs the contract.

E16.quote: Licensee may terminate this Agreement at will by providing Licensor with sixty (60) days' prior written notice.
E16.explanation: This clause allows termination without cause upon notice.

E20.quote: To prevent renewal, a party must deliver written notice of non-renewal no later than ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.
E20.explanation: This clause sets the notice period required to prevent contract renewal.

E24.quote: Reseller shall not, during the Term and for one year thereafter, solicit or accept orders for the Products from any customer introduced to it by Manufacturer
E24.explanation: This clause restricts a party from soliciting the other party's customers after termination.

E28.quote: Company grants Partner the sole right to market the Services to hospitals in the State of Texas.
E28.explanation: This clause grants exclusive marketing rights for a specific territory.

E32.quote: Any attempted assignment in violation of this Section shall be null and void.
E32.explanation: This clause restricts assignment by declaring unauthorized assignments void.

E34.quote: Consultant agrees that all deliverables shall be deemed 'works made for hire' and that Client shall own all copyrights therein.
E34.explanation: This clause transfers intellectual property ownership to the counterparty.

E38.quote: Supplier represents that the prices charged to Buyer are no higher than those charged to any other customer for comparable quantities.
E38.explanation: This clause requires the supplier to offer prices at least as favorable as those given to any other customer.

E43.quote: Upon any breach of the exclusivity covenant in Section 4, Distributor shall pay Company a fixed sum of $50,000 per occurrence.
E43.explanation: This clause fixes a predetermined sum payable upon breach.

E45.quote: Company or its independent accountant may examine Distributor's books and records relating to sales of the Products.
E45.explanation: This clause gives a party the right to inspect or audit the other's records.
